h1: The 8 Best TV Stands on Wheels of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best TV Stands on Wheels 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: eight rolling TV stands compared on TV size range, weight rating, locking wheels, VESA support and tip-over stability.
summary: A rolling TV stand is only as good as its locks and base. The TVON Heavy Duty is the best pick for families because every wheel locks and it has a built-in outlet strip, the Mobile TV Stand for 32-75 inch TVs is the budget buy, and the Perlegear has the widest base.
intro: Most people shop rolling TV stands by screen size and ignore the wheels. The detail that decides whether the stand is safe is how many casters lock and how wide the base is, because a tall mast with a heavy TV moves the center of gravity upward.

We reviewed eight stands and ranked them using the listed TV range, weight rating, locking wheels, VESA support and base design. We did not weigh anything ourselves, and the numbers below are the stated ones.

products.name: TVON Heavy Duty Rolling TV Stand with Power Outlet, 32-83 Inch
products.verdict: All four wheels lock, and a 12A outlet strip is built in.
products.description:
The TVON fits 32 to 83 inch TVs up to 110 lbs, adjusts from 44 to 65 inches and supports VESA 100x100mm to 600x400mm. It adds a 4-outlet, 12A power strip and cable management, and sells in the $50-100 bracket.

It beats the other 110 lb carts because every wheel locks, not just two, and the outlets remove the need for a separate power strip. The Mount-It! adds a camera tray, but at a higher price.

Buy it for homes with kids or pets. Skip it if you need a camera tray.
products.idealFor: Family rooms with kids and pets.

products.name: Perlegear Rolling TV Stand for 32-84 Inch TV, Heavy-Duty Base
products.verdict: The widest base in the roundup, with a safety screw backup.
products.description:
The Perlegear fits 32 to 84 inch TVs up to 100 lbs, with 11 height levels, a 29.34 by 23.14 inch base, a cold-rolled steel frame and a safety screw backup. Its rubber wheels suit hardwood and carpet. It sits in the $100-200 bracket.

It ranks second behind the TVON because it costs more and lists a lower weight rating, but the base size is a real stability advantage.

Buy it if tip-over worries you. Skip it if floor space is tight.

products.name: Mobile TV Stand Rolling TV Cart with Lockable Wheels, 32-83 Inch
products.verdict: Fast assembly and 15 height steps at a mid price.
products.description:
This cart fits 32 to 83 inch TVs up to 110 lbs, adjusts from 44 to 64 inches in 15 steps, supports VESA up to 600x400mm and uses a space-saving base. Two of its four casters have brakes. It is in the $50-100 bracket.

It ranks below the TVON since only half its casters brake. Its edge is fine height control.

Buy it for offices or schools buying several. Skip it if you want every wheel locked.

products.name: Mount-It! Tall Mobile TV Cart for 37-70 Inch TVs with Camera Tray
products.verdict: A dual shelf, webcam tray and lifetime warranty.
products.description:
The Mount-It! fits 37 to 70 inch TVs up to 110 lbs, tilts 10 degrees each way, has two locking casters, a dual shelf plus webcam tray and VESA up to 600x400mm. It carries a lifetime warranty and costs in the $100-200 bracket.

It ranks fourth because the price is higher and size range is narrower than the TVON, but it is the one built for conferencing.

Buy it for a home office. Skip it for TVs above 70 inches.

products.name: PERLESMITH Rolling TV Stand with Wheels for 32-85 Inch TVs
products.verdict: Handles up to 85 inch TVs with tilt and internal cable routing.
products.description:
The PERLESMITH fits 32 to 85 inch TVs up to 100 lbs, with 39.37 to 59.06 inch height, lockable casters, tilt of minus 10 and plus 5 degrees, internal cable routing and both camera and A/V shelves. It sits in the $100-200 bracket.

Fifth place reflects a weight rating that trails the 110 lb carts and the price is higher than the TVON.

Buy it for an 85 inch TV. Skip it if you need a taller mast.

products.name: Mobile TV Stand with Upgraded Wheels for 32-75 Inch TVs
products.verdict: The straightforward budget stand for bedrooms and living rooms.
products.description:
This stand takes 32 to 75 inch screens weighing up to 88 lbs, adjusts from 44 to 56 inches, locks its front wheels and supports VESA 100x100mm to 400x400mm. It has a middle AV shelf and cable management, in the $50-100 bracket.

It ranks sixth because the rating is lower and only front wheels lock.

Buy it for a light TV that moves occasionally. Skip it if you have a heavy set.

products.name: FITUEYES Rolling TV Stand with Landscape to Portrait Rotation
products.verdict: The only stand here that rotates to portrait.
products.description:
The FITUEYES handles 32 to 75 inch screens at 88 lbs, rotates from landscape to portrait, swivels 40 degrees and locks all wheels. It has an iron base and rear cable management, in the $100-200 bracket.

It ranks seventh because the rating is lower and the price higher than the TVON, but portrait rotation is unique.

Buy it for creators or retail displays. Skip it for plain TV use.
products.skipIf: You just want a TV stand.

products.name: Heavy Duty Mobile TV Cart for 55-120 Inch TVs, Holds Up to 250 lbs
products.verdict: The only cart rated for 120 inch and 250 lb displays.
products.description:
This cart fits 55 to 120 inch TVs up to 250 lbs, supports VESA up to 800x600mm, uses locking swivel casters and has a height-adjustable 44 lb shelf on a wide welded steel base. It sits in the $200-500 bracket.

It ranks last only because few homes need it and it costs the most.

Buy it for commercial displays. Skip it for a typical living room TV.

whatMatters.detail: Casters with brakes keep the cart still. A cart with only two locking wheels can still creep. Check the listing for how many lock, and favor all four if kids or pets are near.
The rating is the heaviest TV the cart is rated for. Check your TV's weight in its manual, and leave headroom.
VESA is the bolt pattern on the back of the TV. If your pattern is larger than the cart supports, it will not fit. Check the numbers, like 600x400mm.
A wide base resists tipping. Compare base dimensions, like 29.34 by 23.14 inches, with your floor space.
Eye level depends on your seating. Check the minimum and maximum mast height.

faq.a: Only if your TV size, weight and VESA pattern are within range. Check each listing.
Ignoring VESA. A TV with a larger pattern will not mount.

faq.q: Is the Perlegear worth it over the TVON?
faq.a: If tip-over safety is your top worry, its wide base helps. Otherwise the TVON costs less and locks all wheels.

faq.q: How do I set it up?
faq.a: Assemble, mount the TV low on the mast first, then lock the wheels.
Check bolts every few months and keep wheels free of debris.

faq.q: Can I rotate my TV to portrait?
faq.a: Only the FITUEYES lists landscape to portrait rotation here.

finalTake: The TVON Heavy Duty is the best pick for most homes thanks to all-wheel locks and built-in outlets. Choose the Perlegear if stability matters most, and the Mobile TV Stand for 32-75 inch TVs if budget does. Always match VESA and weight before buying.
